identitySignals: Name matches a California LLC 'Rigorous Love L.L.C.' with a principal address in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location (bizprofile.net, California file number shown)

Website rigorouslove.com describes transformative justice training and school discipline systems work, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' and 'Classroom & academic programs' categories
Website services page lists work with schools on transformative discipline, healing spaces and circles, consistent with school-site services agreements (LIFE Academy, Elmhurst United Middle School)
research.notes: Entity number and legal name come from a third-party aggregator of California Secretary of State filings (bizprofile.net), not the SOS site itself. The public contact page lists only individuals' personal gmail addresses and no phone or general inbox, so email/phone are omitted. The registered principal address may be a residence, so it was omitted. Agenda text does not say LLC; the LLC match rests on name and Oakland location.

profile.summary: Rigorous Love is a two-person team of social justice educators in Oakland, California. They offer training, presentations, coaching, and circles to help schools, organizations and communities build practices of transformative justice, including discipline approaches that focus on repairing harm.

sources.title: Rigorous Love L.L.C. Oakland, CA - filing information

review.notes: Rigorous Love L.L.C. (CA entity 202106810437, active, Oakland principal address, per bizprofile.net) matches the agenda name and city, and the site's team page (not cited) places the two educators in East Oakland and at Elmhurst United, which matches OUSD's Elmhurst United Middle School agreements. The site confirms the 'duo of social justice educators' and the training, coaching, circles and healing-space services; the summary is neutral and the Oakland location is supported by the filing.
